data.gender_notes: Ramshaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ramshaa is derived from the Arabic word 'Ramash', which means 'a garden of roses'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Islamic culture. The name Ramshaa carries the meaning “Garden of Roses” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Ramshaa usually hope their child will grow to embody garden of roses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ramshaa signifies the love and care of Allah towards his creation. It represents the idea of nurturing and growing, just as a garden is tended and cared for.
data.etymology: Ramshaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden of Roses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramshaa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name is also in line with the Islamic emphasis on nature, particularly flowers, as a source of inspiration and wonder.
